raw: Agent Name: WebSurfer, Step Number: 30, Reason for Mistake: While applying Redfin filters, WebSurfer entered both the start and end dates into the same input field (id 634), so the January 2023 date range was never correctly set. This misconfiguration led to repeated looping without retrieving the needed results and directly caused the failure to identify the lowest sale price.
